published_ranges._notes: Creality K1-series parameter table (2024-12-23) recommends 220C nozzle, 45C bed, 300 mm/s optimal speed, 23 mm3/s max volume flow, 100% model fan; K2 Plus table recommends 220C nozzle, 50C bed, 35C chamber, 23 mm3/s. These are printer profile values, not published ranges, so max volumetric speed is not set in fields. Hyper PLA RFID and Spool-Free Hyper PLA RFID are sold as the same Hyper PLA material (RFID tag / refill format); assumed to share this entry. Density not found on an official source (resellers quote 1.25 g/cm3).

conflicts: Diameter tolerance: Creality's own Amazon listing title (ASIN B0CLTY4MML, sold by Creality CL Store) says 'Dimensional Accuracy +/-0.02mm'; its bullet and Creality's PLA guide say 1.75+/-0.03mm.
